call_graph.relationship: API table binds capture_accessibility_tree to the exported extern system callback.
extern system callback runs the session FFI body inside catch_unwind_ffi.
Pointer/null/session/ABI/viewport checks precede session capture; bounded JSON encoding and owned byte allocation follow snapshot construction.
Capture clamps viewport dimensions, calls runtime_ui accessibility_snapshot with public output limit, and only substitutes a preview snapshot for no UI.
Rejects excessive source node count, creates one cumulative budget, rebuilds each Surface, uses bounded capture/globalization, merges local outputs and validates final payload.
Global ID/path replacements observe the delta before each field write; this caller explains shared replacement semantics.
Public/internal Surface wrappers call the two owned extraction entry points; returned DTOs own their data.
Surface text cache is the rich semantic compilation owner; &self access can fill its internal cache, so no global Surface immutability claim.
Action dispatch captures current snapshot before validating target. Action implementation is outside the exact16 source coverage.
